tagline: Mind maps at typing speed: Tab for a child, Enter for a sibling.
description:
Close it, come back, or send someone your copy — the same bubbles are there.

Click a bubble and type. Tab inserts a child, Enter a sibling, arrows walk the map, Delete removes a node. Drag to pan, wheel to zoom. Colours, layouts (map, graph, tree), shapes, and a yes/no status live on each item. New starts a blank map.

On a phone, tap a bubble to select it, tap again to type, and use Child / Sibling / Edit / Delete at the bottom.

Press Invite in the bar above so a friend can watch the same map.

An unofficial port of My Mind by Ondřej Žára. Same map, same keys.
